passiveEffects.name: Oblivious
passiveEffects.originalDescription: When Slowbro receives damage, the HP loss is gradual. When damaging an opponent with a move, restore some of the remaining gradual HP loss and decrease the target's Sp. Defense. Slowbro stores up lost HP for a short time (blue HP). Slowbro's Oblivious health remains for 6s and then decreases by 3% max HP every second. When dealing damage to an enemy with Water Gun, Scald, Surf, or Slowbeam - decrease their Sp. Def by 4% for 5s, stacking up to 5 times.

moveEffects.name: Water Gun
moveEffects.originalDescription: Slowbro channels a fierce stream of water which deals damage and lowers movement speed. Increase the area of effect and damage the longer this move is channeled. Slowbro fires a stream of water, damaging and slowing enemies hit by 35% for 1s. This move can be channeled to increase its range and damage. Slowbro's movement speed is reduced by 30% while channeling. Restore 10% of Slowbro's Oblivious health (blue HP) once, after hitting an enemy.

moveEffects.name: Slack Off
moveEffects.originalDescription: Lay down and take a rest, continuously regaining health. Damage taken will reduce the recovery effect. Slowbro begins channeling a nap and gains a heal over time, healing 2% max HP every 0.5s for 3s. While Slowbro remains channeling its nap, all self-healing is doubled (including Slack Off healing). Slowbro can be manually or forcibly woken up from their nap.

uniteMoveEffects.originalDescription: Stare at an enemy and attack continually, dealing damage and rooting them. Grants a shield and makes the user immune to hindrances while using this move. Stare at an enemy and attack continually, dealing damage every .5 seconds for 3s and applying 'Bound' to them. This ability counters Unstoppable.
